page.overview:
What is 153rd Branch?

153rd Branch belongs to One Piece. The 153rd Branch is a Marine Base at Shells Town and the seat of the 153rd Marine Branch in East Blue.

After Morgan was promoted from the rank of Chief Petty Officer to Lieutenant Commander for reportedly capturing the infamous "Kuro", and later making his way up to the rank of Captain, he became corrupted by his newfound fame. He went on to tyrannize the entire 153rd Branch, along with the town under its jurisdiction, for three years—an abuse of power in which his son, Helmeppo, eagerly took part. Their reign of terror came to an end when Luffy and Zoro defeated Morgan.
